// A skeletal animation clip: one transform track per bone, parallel to the
// target skeleton's bone array, plus trigger events. Track values are local
// (parent-relative) transforms.
type SkeletalClip
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Duration: Duration;
    BoneTracks: Array<TransformTrack3D>;
    Events: Array<AnimationEvent>;
}
